title: EvidencePackageManifest (Protocol Qv Rev 7)
description: Manifest for notified-body / release evidence package. Includes per-file sha256, package signature, receipts and QVM fields. Annotated to map to ISO 42001, NIST, and EU AI Act evidence requirements.

package_signature.description: SHA-256 (or equivalent) of concatenated file hashes + ts. Used as package-level signature for insurer/regulator audit.

quantum_verification_hash.description: Optional QVM verification proof for package (Rev7 augmentation).

joules_total.description: Optional aggregate energy usage for package creation (joules).

evidence_owner.description: Owner (team/person) responsible for the evidence package.
